conditions: Concurrent real traffic on the same interface, fresh separate SQLite databases and identical local City/ASN files; 45-second warm-up followed by 300 seconds of sampling.
Both compositor windows were 1440x1040 logical pixels, scale 1, dark mode, English, graph view. Their internal layouts and chrome differ.
Normal controls enabled; no capture policy changes, local inference or on-demand inspections during the window. Collectors had CAP_NET_RAW only; frontends had no capabilities.
Counts include each collector and the complete frontend process tree. All helper processes were stable during the measurement.
RSS is summed process RSS, so shared pages can be counted more than once. PSS apportions shared resident pages; every process supplied readable PSS for all 300 samples.
CPU includes all process threads; 100% means one logical core. Observer, compositor, unrelated applications, kernel buffers and GPU VRAM are excluded.
Native production capture defaults use a 4096-byte non-promiscuous IPv4/IPv6/ARP capture; Python uses 65535-byte promiscuous IPv4/IPv6 capture. Algorithms and observed node counts differ.
The upstream Electron main/preload/frontend were retained; a private adapter attaches the separately measured Python collector and adds numeric timing probes. Runtime was Electron 44.9.1.
Both frontends had numeric timing probes enabled and took a screenshot during warm-up. Instrumentation is included in the measured app processes.
Native timing records egui update callbacks and a worker-thread repaint request to the next update. Electron records requestAnimationFrame callbacks and an IPC request through the next rAF response.

The timing mechanisms differ. These are scheduling and responsiveness observations, not hardware-presented FPS, equal-cadence rendering, input-to-photon latency or a direct relative latency benchmark.
Both RSS values grew. This five-minute Linux workload does not establish multi-hour stability, feature parity, cross-platform resource use or maximum throughput.
The completed background cohort is retained unchanged and was measured separately. Do not subtract its averages from this run to estimate frontend costs.
